name: mobile-ground-truth
description: Four mobile commands that answer from the tree and the toolchain rather than from memory: API availability, crash triage, upgrade impact, privacy declarations.

skills.name: api-check
skills.line: Answer whether an API exists in the SDK you build against and whether it runs on the oldest OS you ship to, from files on this machine, never from memory.

skills.name: crash-triage
skills.line: Triage a mobile crash only when the trace is symbolicated and its symbols proven to match the shipped build; otherwise name what is missing and stop.

skills.name: privacy-declarations
skills.line: Draft the privacy-manifest and data-safety inputs a store asks for from what the code evidences, marking everything unevidenced as undeclarable.

skills.name: upgrade-impact
skills.line: Report only the breaking changes in an upgrade that actually occur in this repository, with the compiler's own deprecation output as the evidence.
